readings.heading: Ὁ Ἀπόστολος — 2 Corinthians 2:3–15
verses: 3. Brothers and sisters: and I wrote you this very thing, so that when I came I would not have sorrow from the people I ought to have joy from. I am confident about all of you, that my joy is the joy of you all.
4. For I wrote to you out of great distress and anguish of heart, through many tears — not to make you grieve, but so that you would know the love I have for you in such abundance.
5. But if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me only — but in part, not to put it too heavily, all of you.
6. This punishment from the majority is enough for such a person.
7. So the opposite is what you should do now: rather forgive him and encourage him, or he may be swallowed up by excessive sorrow.
8. That is why I am urging you to confirm your love for him.
9. I wrote for this reason as well — so that I might know you under trial, whether you are obedient in everything.
10. Anyone you forgive anything, I forgive too. For what I have forgiven — if I have forgiven anything — I have forgiven for your sake, in the presence of Christ,
11. so that we are not outwitted by Satan. We are not ignorant of his designs.
12. When I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ, and a door was opened to me in the Lord,
13. I still had no rest in my spirit, because I did not find my brother Titus. So I said goodbye to them and went on into Macedonia.
14. But thanks be to God, who always leads us in Christ's triumph, and through us spreads the fragrance of the knowledge of him in every place.
15. For we are the sweet aroma of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing.

readings.heading: Τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον — Matthew 23:13–22
verses: 13. At that time the Lord said: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You devour widows' houses, and for a show you make long prayers. For that you will receive a heavier judgment.
14. Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in people's faces. You yourselves do not go in, and you will not let those who are going in enter either.
15. Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! You travel sea and land to make one convert — and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a child of Gehenna as you are.
16. Woe to you, blind guides, who say, 'If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound.'
17. Fools and blind men! Which is greater — the gold, or the temple that makes the gold holy?
18. And, 'If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound.'
19. Fools and blind men! Which is greater — the gift, or the altar that makes the gift holy?
20. So whoever swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
21. And whoever swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.
22. And whoever swears by heaven swears by the throne of God and by the One who sits on it."
